reviews.title: Best in workouts
reviews.text: This app is great. All of the programs have step by step videos with Tammy showing proper form etc. you feel like your working out with her. Having a lot of success with my body at 48yrs old. Tammy knows all the right moves and will keep you looking your best.

reviews.title: From app to action
reviews.text: This app has helped me get back in the gym with a plan that built my confidence and consistency. Thankful for this empowerment!

reviews.title: Such an amazing app
reviews.text: I love that I can do everything all in one app from counting my water intake to counting macros and of course keeping up with workouts! From the app you can participate in challenges or just workout on your own time and there’s are so many options from weight training to Pilates and yoga!

reviews.title: My favorite fitness app 🤎
reviews.text: I’m not one to leave reviews often… I’ve been trying fitness programs and apps ever since the original BBG pdf guide from Kayla Itsines came out, and I honestly say Tammy Fit has become one of my favorites. I learned about Tammy’s training style as soon as I was getting the courage to step in a gym. I signed up for the app and immediately loved the whole vibe like the aesthetic, the layout… everything feels super clean and user friendly. It’s been such a reliable app for me since my gym newbie years, and they keep updating it in ways that make it better. I love all the workout program options, the meal plans and the mindfulness section. It really feels like a well rounded fitness app. I recently joined one the challenges and it’s been so motivating to see a glimpse into the community right inside the app. Tammy Fit is definitely worth trying if you’re looking for a fitness app that is pretty, motivating and actually gets you results.

reviews.title: I will always have this app!
reviews.text: I have had the TammyFit app for a few years and I love it!! I had my 3rd baby in August 2024 and within one year I have managed to lose 40lbs! Watching Tammy’s form while working out has definitely made working out easier and helps to not injure yourself if you are a beginner. Love it!!

reviews.title: It has changed the game!
reviews.text: I’ve been with TammyFit since before this app was even a thing. I love everything about this app, the yearly fee is definitely worth it. Meal plans + workout plans all in one, I couldn’t be more pleased. Sometimes there are small issues but the team is super quick to fix the bugs within couple of hours. I’ll forever be with TammyFit!

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text: The app has constant bugs and doesn’t work a lot of the time. I purchased a 60$ program and it won’t allow me to view the workouts without saying I need to spend an additional 45$ in the middle of the month. Save your money!!

reviews.title: Keeps force quitting
reviews.text: This app keeps changing. I get making improvements but every time I figure out how to use it they switch everything around and I can’t find my workouts. Now today every time I click on a workout it force quits. Frustrating considering how expen$$$$ive it is

reviews.title: A lot of errors
reviews.text:
I love the concept of this app. Everything you need in one place. I’ve been using the app one and off for about four years now and throughout this time have discovered some key things. 

For example, if my goal is to lose, I can specific that but it does not ask me what my goal weight is. It does not adjust the macros to account for this goal reduction. Even if I manually adjust the macros, the meal plan will not update to reflect those new parameters.

reviews.title: Videos do not load
reviews.text: This is my second time trying to use Tammy’s app, as I’m a huge fan of her. However, the app disappoints. The videos do not load. Leaving me to read and try to figure out form. I’ve even tried pre loading them at home where service is strong and still they do not load. I would be recommend

reviews.title: Retired body builder
reviews.text: Love this for keeping up with workouts now that I don’t lift the way I did when I was younger. Easy to be consistent and takes all of the thinking out of my fitness routine! Won’t stop recommending it to my friends. And my picky eater boyfriend loves the meals. It’s made my life so much easier.

reviews.title: Paid subscription with ads
reviews.text: It’s super frustrating this app has ad pop ups when you are paying to use it! I’m considering deleting this app despite  having paid for months of this because I shouldn’t be dealing with underwear pop up ads when I’m paying to use this app! I understand advertising app upgrades but product ads when I’m trying to workout is very frustrating

reviews.title: Everything in one place!
reviews.text: I’ve been using the app for years for everything from booty workouts to post partum. I love that they’ve added yoga, Pilates and core recovery. Really terrific amount of content. 100% recommend! Bonus is I love supporting one of Tammy’s businesses bc I’m a long time follower of hers.

reviews.title: ⚠️WARNING⚠️ MOST ADDICTING FITNESS APP!
reviews.text: Be careful getting this app! I downloaded it 5 years ago and I’m absolutely obsessed. If you want to get yourself into a healthy lifestyle, you’re at the right place! Meal plans, Pilates, Gym workouts, at home workouts, post-pregnancy programs, HITT…do I need to go on? All for such a cheap price! The level for just one of these programs would be the same as in-person class at the gym. Not only that, the amount you would pay for a month in any in-person gym class is more expensive than a whole year of the app! And it’s all available in the palms of your hands! The meal recipes are absolutely delicious and so healthy, you won’t want to stop making them. And most of the recipes include most of the ingredients you have in your pantry at home! Make the right choice for yourself, are start with TammyFit. Enjoy the addition to the healthy lifestyle!

reviews.title: Bugs that need fixing
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for about 6 years now and the most recent makeover they did left a lot to be desired. It doesn’t keep track of the weights you’re doing even when you input them. So when I get to that workout the next week it’s set back to “0 lb” again so what’s the point of being able to enter the weights? I also wish it allowed you to select which days you want to do rest on, rather than just choosing for you because if I miss a day the schedule is just all messed up. There are some other odd UX bugs too, the app development team needs to go through everything with a fine toothed comb because there’s some odd instances where you can’t type in certain boxes in the settings/profile section, you can’t keep track of the weights, the videos aren’t syncing with the actual workout (it’ll show me the video for the next or previous workout) etc. The list goes on, anyone who actually uses this app daily as intended feels my pain which almost makes it more frustrating considering the issues are so blatant and haven’t been fixed even with the latest “bug fix” update. Unfortunate because the programs are excellent but for what we are paying you would think the app would at least be more functional. Kind of frustrating.

reviews.title: UPDATED REVIEW
reviews.text:
I am coming up on a year and a half of using the TammyFit app and it has enriched my life SO much. I am currently doing my 4th challenge from the app. The results it’s provided mentally and physically are what keep me coming back for more every single time 👏🏽🎉

I am a new single-mom so having this app has allowed me to save time and money by not having to go to the gym to get my workout in. Outside of the challenge, I utilize the Yoga program and individual workouts (there is literally everything booty, arms, legs, core, etc.) and I’m telling you right now, I genuinely love the person I’ve become FROM USING THIS APP. It feels unreal that I can experience this AND for an affordable price 🥲 

Thank you Tammy and especially the TammyFit team for everything y’all do within the app, community, and for me personally! I LOVE THIS SO MUCH!!

reviews.title: ❤️‍🔥🤭🍑 let’s go girls !!!
reviews.text: I finally did it I joined the Tammy fit challenge hehe ✨🍑I came across the anoucment late at night and committed right then and there to do it 5 days in the gym !! I felt so right that this was the time to do what I have been hesitating ( I had a health issue for a couple years and I could not do a consistent like this without getting sick or feeling horrible , I feel so blessed to be able to do this now after healthy supplements, working with applied kinesiology, and first and foremost God leading me to healing and ultimately healing me ) for one reason or another and wanting to do for a while now, I truly believe God put it in my feed !! It has given so much motivation at a time where I really needed a hard re-set and to get passed silly insecurities and time drainers from over thinking to feeling like I couldn’t do 5 days in the gym a week I HAVE OVERCOME 🔥!! Yes lord heheh , I have followed Tammy since I was 19 and love her yt workouts and lifestyle then I saw she made an app and wanted to try it out and now I finally am !!! So Very excited to be on the 9 week strong journey ** I wrote this last part during my first week** on my first week so far so awesome I’m very sore but going to the gym everyday has funnily enough helped me recover faster even when I think there’s no way I can do this ! I do it and I’m like WOAH hahah thanks Tammy! ** back to the present ** I am living it and loving it I am on week 4 now wow and a whole new pod of workouts has me so fired up🔥🤭 i Involve my friends and sista when our schedules link up and it kills em in a good way haha! I legit get excited to do my workouts and hit up the gym as a healthy ritual my strength has gone through the roof- I no longer have random anxiety about going back to back to the gym - and I have gotten multiple compliments already from friends and family about my body composition change and how quickly it is responding !! I see it too 🥹new muscle new strength new energy new healthy habits LETZZ GOOO ✨I love you Tammy thank you for this from the bottom of my heart ❤️‍🔥 “the ladies are doing it for themselves “ hehehe!

reviews.title: The last fitness app you’ll ever need!!
reviews.text: TammyFit has been an absolute lifeline for me. It's not just about workouts and meal plans; it's about the journey it's taken me on – a journey of self-love and transformation. When I first started using TammyFit, I was struggling with confidence and feeling lost in my fitness journey. But with each workout and meal, I felt myself getting stronger, not just physically, but mentally too! If you do better with a gym buddy, join the challenges as well because the sense of community within TammyFit is truly something special. It's like having a cheerleading squad in your pocket, supporting you through every high and low. Thanks to TammyFit, I've not only seen changes in my body, but I've also found a newfound sense of self-belief and empowerment. Something I had definitely lost after becoming a mum. I also can’t speak highly enough of the customer support team. They’re incredibly helpful and kind, going above and beyond to make sure your app experience runs smoothly and all of your questions are answered. If you're ready to embark on a life-changing and holistic wellness journey, I can't recommend TammyFit enough. It's not just an app; it's a beacon of hope and inspiration on the path to becoming the best version of yourself. P.S.- I’d like to add that there is a large variety of workout styles on the app if you don’t enjoy lifting weights, and there are even several guided meditation videos on there that even the busiest person can find time for because they offer short ones as well.

reviews.title: Such a good community
reviews.text: I really loved using this after the purpose of keeping up with a six week challenge that I've been participating in. The app is really pretty, it has everything I need, and really provides a lot of workouts of different types. It's easy to add friends and keep up with your challenge along with your nutrition. My favorite part is going through out and being able to see your progress until you get to the end and it shows a checkmark on the calendar! The only critique I would give to the UI of the app itself is that I think there are too many tabs, sometimes I feel like I'm clicking on multiple pages on the bottom of the app to find the challenge or the menu that I want.

reviews.title: I’ve been using for months!!
reviews.text: Love love this app. I really stuck with this one because they include meditations and affirmations that have really transformed my daily life. The workouts are simple enough that anybody could easily see progress with following the steps but as someone who has been using the gym for over 5 years and even had experience with several personal trainers, these workouts show results QUICK 😍

reviews.title: The best fitness app!
reviews.text: I’ve had a few different fitness apps and I’ve done my fair share of fitness challenges. But, i absolutely love that this has your grocery lists for the meals you’ll be having each day. As a busy mom, that helps soooo much! Sometimes we have the right idea of what foods are healthy to eat but then we buy it and have no clue what to do with it and/or food goes to waste.  With her meals you have exactly what you need on your grocery list and you don’t have to worry about wasting food. I also love that the meals are so delicious and fulfilling! Not to mention she also has the food tracker so you don’t need a different app to keep track! Oh and I love that all I have to do is follow the schedule for my workouts and the follow along videos help me so much! My kids even jump in and work out with me!

reviews.title: Needs improvement
reviews.text: Love the app! Unfortunately every time I log my meals and come back later they are no longer there. It gets pretty exhausting to continue to have to re enter them in. All but about gave up at this point. If this glitch were to be improved would definitely give it five stars. Don’t know if I’ll continue paying until then.

reviews.title: My favorite workout app!!!
reviews.text: I have had used at least 4 workout apps and this one is by far my favorite and have been steady using it for 2 years now! There is so much variety for workouts, from Pilates to weightlifting to pregnancy and postpartum workouts and stretches and warm ups and meditations to clear your mind there is everything. And no other app also includes meals plans and recipes. The Tammy fit app really is an everything all in one place workout app to help you with your workout goals!

reviews.title: Crashing
reviews.text: App always crashes/needs to be deleted to update before I finish a program

reviews.title: Motivating
reviews.text: I’ve been using Tammy Fit for over a year and have made amazing gains in my health and fitness journey. The workouts, meals and recipes are excellent. I’m more confidant now in my mid 40’s than I was in my mid 20’s

reviews.title: absolutely worth it!!
reviews.text: love love love this app. extremely helpful, informative and organized. also absolutely love the videos showing you how to do the exercises!!

reviews.title: The gains!
reviews.text: I’ve always been a skinny/petite girl. I’ve had 3 kids and although I stayed skinny, my stomach was stretched out and I just looked skinny fat. This app not only slimmed my waist but made my glutes and legs grow! HIGHLY recommend ❤️💋

reviews.title: Amazing programs in one app!
reviews.text: I’ve used the Tammy app several years now and always come back to the programs because they have provided meaningful results. While the app is known for its signature booty program and a thousand glute exercises variations so that I never get bored, it also has an excellent full body program and hosts challenges that build a sense of community. I’ve also completed various Pilates and Ab workout variations to spice things up and keep things interesting on off days. Most importantly, I love the structured programs, how to videos, which make me more confident when I’m going to the gym because I know exactly what I’m doing and I have a plan. I’ve seen great body recomp results and have built a nice back “shelf” only three weeks into doing a curve building challenge program, so I know it’s working. The icing on the cake is the well stocked meal plan, including for for vegan diets, that provide meal high protein meal ideas essential for building muscle. If you’re a beginner or just looking for some structure in your gym routine, I highly recommend this app.

reviews.title: Amazing challenges and community
reviews.text: I haven’t worked out consistently since before I became a mom 3ish years ago. I just had my second baby 4 months ago and have been wanting to get stronger and healthier again but didn’t know where to start. The Tammyfit app has taken out all of hard work for me by providing workout plans, challenges, and meal plans so all I have to do is just show up and do it! I’m doing a 6 week challenge and the community and support form the Tammyfit team and the other participants has been amazing! So far I’m obsessed and want to do every challenge going forward.🤪🙌🏼

reviews.title: Terrible Update
reviews.text:
Update!
I have used this app for years and then one morning I opened it up and there had been an update and it was not good. I was so disappointed I left a one star review! The developer reached out and so began a conversation about the changes. It seems to be back to pre-update with the ability for them to expand the workout options (?) and I'm really pleased. So back to a five star review for me.

reviews.title: New update is awful!
reviews.text: I’ve been a long time user and lover of this app. I use the workout programs daily and have been for 4 or more years. This new update is awful! I don’t know why they changed anything, the app was perfect the way it was before. It is so clunky now and so difficult to find anything. I cannot find any of the programs I’ve used in the past as they’ve changed all the names and exercises. The weights you can input for each exercise no longer save. Your music will stop paying if you use the timers on the timed exercises. It’s all around terrible! Please change it back, I use this app daily and it was so seamless before.

reviews.title: used to be perfect but the recent update needs tweaking!
reviews.text: i’ve had this app for years and have always loved it! however, after the recent update/revamp of the app i think the devs or tammy should take another look at the app. before it used to be so simple - i could easily find a program, gym or home, and easily know where to start based off their names (gym booty v1, gym booty v2, etc). the versions also got progressively more difficult which made this naming scheme even easier so that beginners knew where to start. however, the recent revamp has changed all of this where now some programs are no longer clear whether they’re for the gym or for your home (unless you open it up and take a look through) and all the names have changed! no longer is it easy to say, okay i’ll start with v1 and work my way through all of the other versions. now i don’t know which program is better for beginners and which is more advanced like before. the aesthetics are great but the functionality has unfortunately taken a hit as it’s become more complicated to navigate. please reconsider the update to these programs, with their new names and (seemingly) different workouts! everything was great and simple the way it was before 🫶🏼 also, you’re able to filter the workouts but not the programs - please add filtering for these as well!

reviews.title: The app needs improvements
reviews.text:
The are bugs in the app. 1. Switching between exercises sometimes make the video to be replaced with the next exercise video. 2. Completed day not always shows as completed until you actually click on that day. 3. Switching between navigation tabs sometimes make the pages display as empty/with no content. 
Also, why can’t I do 2 programs at the same time? If, for example, I want to do abs and full body workouts because I don’t like the program for some of the days in full body and would like to do abs instead? Or i would like to do the booty and full body in parallel but app doesn’t have such possibility. Also I would like to have a warmup suggestions and rest time between sets suggestions. Videos and staged photos are esthetics but the overall app usage is not convenient to me.

reviews.title: New Update is Dissapointing
reviews.text: I generally love this app but the new update just made it 10x worse. It’s now even glitchier than it was before and what’s worse is I was finishing up week 6 of my program and with the update some of the workouts are completely different so I’m having to switch up when I was almost to the finish line of my program. The app was always kinda glitchy before but I don’t know why you would update it to look different and the glitches aren’t even gone. I am so disappointed about this. Wish I could remove the update :(. Always been a fan of this app, I’ve been using it since 2020 but I really wish they would address the glitches and typos. On one of my workouts they put the same exercise twice in a row it’s DB Tricep Extension and the Dumbbell Tricep Extension for the next one…there seems to be a lot of errors like this.

reviews.title: This update nnooouuurrrrrr
reviews.text: The app was lovely!!!!!! Until…. This update. It seems to lags and isn’t as aesthetically satisfying.

reviews.title: Bad update
reviews.text: The new update changed things that were the apps best features to me and it zoomed in the mobile viewing making it harder to read and less appealing to view as well as whipping my history starting from day one again having to go back and fix everything I set for myself

reviews.title: How fake
reviews.text: Of course this is an app made by Tammy, just wanting a lot of people’s money.   Once you make your account, it takes you straight to selecting a plan and it isn’t cheap at all..just to work out? And if you don’t want to, it just logs you out.   No  free exercises you can do or tracking your work outs. Will be deleting the app and won’t be ever redownloading it

reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.text: I’ve been using the app for a little over a week now and I love it! It has everything you could need for a good workout. There are videos as well as written instructions for each exercise. You can also toggle between home and gym workouts. The meal plans are my favorite, they have about 2 versions for each dietary need (vegan, vegetarian, standard, gluten free, etc) so there is something for everyone! Highly recommend the app. 🩷

reviews.title: this app or nothing!
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the tammyfit app since covid 2020 and it is the only lifestyle/fitness app I’ve used since then! I absolutely love the variety of workouts for at home or in the gym! The programs are super easy to follow and so many options- even simple stretching (which we should ALL be incorporating more into our lives). I even used this app while pregnant! & DO NOT GET ME on the DELICIOUS meal plans 🤤 they are super easy to follow and there are multiple options! 
I cannot recommend this app enough, truly! 🫶🏽🤍

If you are looking to invest in yourself, start with Tammyfit, you will not regret it.

reviews.title: Best Fitness App 🥵
reviews.text: I’ve been in the gym for a while now, inconsistently, and I keep finding myself going to this app for new inspiring workouts that challenge my body. There is such a wide variety of workouts to choose from it’s amazing! Not only are there great programs in this app but there’s so many delicious recipes to help you reach your fitness goals (and they’re not boring recipes lol!) Also her fitness challenges are so good!!

reviews.title: My favorite health app ever!!
reviews.text: I came across Tammy years ago and loved what she was about! When I learned she had finally made an app to help empower others I was all in and have had it all these years since! I love how dedicated Tammy and her team are to constantly improving things in the app for the better and the amount of quick support has been phenomenal with any questions I’ve had. I have never had an issue with this app once which feels so good to have something so reliable! The recipes, food plans, different workouts, stretches and steps to be your best self are perfect! I don’t see myself without this app ever! I’m beyond thankful to the team! Thank you Tammy Fit! XX

reviews.title: 100% worth it!
reviews.text: I honestly can’t recommend this app enough! I’m currently in my third challenge through the app and have had the best experience with all of the features! I always struggled getting into the gym without having a plan or knowing what to do and this app has truly made me overcome that! 10/10🩷

reviews.title: 100% recommend
reviews.text: This is my first time using the app for a challenge and it is so easy to navigate. Everything you need from water intake, to workouts, to recipes, it’s got it all. It can also sync to your watch/phone to track workouts and steps for you to make one less thing for you to worry about. The community it comes with is also amazing and so helpful, encouraging, and inspiring. I can’t wait to continue using the app after this 8 week challenge is over.

reviews.title: Absolutely love the app
reviews.text: Workouts are intense, challenging, and totally worth it! Thanks Tammy for this awesome app!

reviews.title: Glitching :(
reviews.text: The videos and voiceovers for exercises are never in sync and even if they start in sync they inevitably glitch and get out of sync, thus stopping me from my workout to figure out what’s wrong and try to get the app working again

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text: I found this app right after I had my son, and started the postpartum program. This app not only has helped me lose the baby weight, but also helped better my mood, my self confidence, and life! I love everything about it, and recommend it to all of my friends.

reviews.title: Good for beginners
reviews.text: I love it but for it to be 70 usd already then the challenges costing a fee on top of that just seems greedy. Other than that it’s great

reviews.title: WOW! Used many and love this one!!
reviews.text: I have used many workout apps but Tammy fit tops them all.  The nutrition/ recipes/ macros/ different workouts/ challenges.. those are some of my fav things about this app. The videos for each exercise are amazing too.  Helps push me further.

reviews.title: Great app but some minor improvements would help.
reviews.text: I’ve had the week so far and I’m loving it enough to stay past the free trial. Some improvements I would recommend are to be able to add foods easier like MyFitnessPal. Would be beneficial to search an item that’s already in the system (added by someone else at some point) rather than having to manually add every item and it’s macros every single time. It would also be great to be able to move set days in a program to different days in your diary so it works around your own schedule.

reviews.title: Look no further!
reviews.text: This app has it all, easy to follow workouts, meal plans and if your doing a challenge, a great community! I’ve been using the Tammy Fit app for about two years now and I’m absolutely loving it! I love working out, but I loathe having to figure out what workouts to do so this app is a life saver because I don’t have to think about what body part to workout or what workouts to do, I just follow the workout plans that are available! This app is perfect for not only beginners but advanced gym goers as well! I highly recommend this app to anyone looking to get their fitness journey started or for those who are looking to progress in their fitness goals ☺️
